title: How to Store Your AC in Winter: Easy Steps to Avoid a Weak Restart & Costly Repairs
summary: Follow six easy steps to clean, cover, and store your AC before winter. This guide covers filters, mold, pests, voltage, Dhaka service prices, and a March restart plan to avoid costly repairs.
intro: Learn how to store your AC in winter and avoid dust, damp air, and rats before March arrives.
html:
Most users in Bangladesh find their air conditioners not working properly in March, when winter fully ends in our country. When they start their AC for the first time, most people smell a bad smell in their room or notice weaker cooling than the last summer. What actually happens is that we Bangladeshi people usually switch off our air conditioners in November, just before winter arrives, and completely stop using them until the next summer.

Then the first hot day arrives, and we try to start using it after the long break. But till that day, the AC filter gets full of dust. In this blog, we will try to explain today how you should practically maintain your AC before winter in Bangladesh. You will learn easy steps, service cost ideas, and safety tips.

Why Pre-Winter AC Care Matters in Bangladesh

The winter season in Bangladesh is short, but dust and damp air stay around throughout the season. As a result, dust settles on the filters, and mold gradually grows on wet coils. In the outdoor unit, Rats and lizards also start nesting in it and damage the electrical components. As a solution, proper air conditioner winter care can stop these problems at an early stage.

Beyond these problems, most users also notice:

  • Bad smell when the AC restarts just after winter ends
  • Weak cooling after months of rest
  • Water drips from the indoor unit
  • Rats chew wires or pipes
  • Higher repair bills in April

Next, let us answer the question people ask first.

Should You Turn Off Your AC in Winter?

Yes, you can turn off your AC for the cool months. For split AC winter care, use the remote first, then switch off the wall plug or MCB. Clean the filters before you do this.

Is It Safe to Unplug the AC for the Whole Winter?

It is safe to unplug the AC for the whole winter. Pull the plug during thunderstorms and bad voltage days. If you are comfortable with leaving it plugged in, then you can use a good voltage protector. Now let us move to the steps you can finish at home by yourself.

Step-by-Step Guide to AC Maintenance Before Winter

Follow these five steps to finish AC maintenance before winter. First of all, you are going to need a soft brush, mild soap, and a dry cloth.

Step 1: Clean the AC Filters

Dust in Dhaka clogs air conditioner filters fast. So your AC cleaning needs to start with the filters. Switch off the AC and open the front panel. Slide out the filters and brush off loose dust. Wash them in lukewarm water with mild soap, then dry them fully in the shade before you put them back. Be careful about never refilling a wet filter.

Step 2: Dry the Inside to Stop Mold

Damp air builds mold inside the AC over time. Run the fan mode for 20 to 30 minutes after you clean the filters. This dries the coils and the drain tray. Do not spray water inside the AC.

Step 3: Clear the Outdoor Box

Remove leaves, plastic bags, and trash around the outdoor part and try to leave at least 30 cm of free space on all sides. This easy AC off-season maintenance tip lets air flow freely. Do not climb on a ledge to reach it.

Step 4: Use an AC Cover for Winter the Right Way

Many people ask how to store an AC in winter. For a split AC, you only need to protect the outdoor part. Use a breathable cover that fits well. Avoid airtight plastic, because it traps damp air. But do not forget to remove it before you switch the AC on.

Step 5: Protect the AC From Voltage Swings

Voltage swings have a high chance of damaging the compressor and the control board. Thus, install a voltage protector with a start delay as a shield. Wait three minutes before you restart the AC after a power cut. In addition to these, some jobs need an expert, so let us look at them next.

Tasks Need To Be Done By An AC Technician

Keep Rats, Insects, and Lizards Away

Pests often chew wires and nest in pipe holes. So a technician should properly seal the gaps around the pipe hole with putty or foam. Suggest them adding fine mesh to the drain pipe end, but do not block the water flow. However, solving the rat problem is a job for a technician.

Other Service Tasks

Service tasks like refrigerant work, deep coil cleaning, drain repairs, and wiring faults belong to a technician. Doing AC servicing before winter comes also makes sense if your AC had problems last summer. Your AC does not need a gas refill every year, but noticing low gas means a leak somewhere. Ask for a leak test and a pressure check from your technician before any refill.

Tip: Try booking early, because technicians usually get too busy in April in Bangladesh.

Will Self-Cleaning Affect Your Warranty?

Usually, basic filter cleaning does not affect most warranties. Despite that, opening the body, washing coils, or touching the gas line can void it. To avoid taking any chances with your insurance, you must read your warranty card first. When in doubt, you should immediately call the brand service center.

Estimated AC Service Cost

AC servicing cost also matters a lot for Bangladeshi users, so here are the estimated service tariffs from our end. Service charges vary by brand, AC size, and the city where you live. In Bangladesh in Dhaka, basic servicing for a split AC often costs around Tk 1,200 to Tk 2,500. Chattogram, Sylhet, Khulna, and Rajshahi prices are often a little lower compared to Dhaka. Brand rules can also differ, so check your model next.

Tip: These are rough numbers, so try confirming with at least two or three air conditioner service providers.

Different Brand Guidance

Every brand has its own manual, filter design, and warranty conditions. For instance, Haier air conditioner owners can start with the Haier service center in their area. Gree, Midea, and General AC owners should contact the official dealer or service partner. Read the manual for your specific AC model for safe cleaning and cover advice. Well, finding a good technician is the next step.

How to Find a Reliable Technician Near You

Start with the official service center of your brand. You can ask the neighbors in your area for names they trust. Choose a technician who gives a receipt and a service warranty. Avoid technicians who directly suggest a gas refill without a test. Winter still brings a few smart habits, so let us cover those.

Smart Winter Habits: Dehumidify, Stop Mold, and Save Power

Use Dry Mode on Damp Days

Dry mode acts like a dehumidifier on damp days. You should run it for 30 to 60 minutes when the room feels sticky. Fortunately, it often uses less power than cooling mode.

Stop Mold in AC During Winter

To stop mold in the AC during winter, run the fan mode for 30 minutes once a month. Keep the filters clean and dry.

Tips to Save Electricity

Clean filters can significantly save power because when they are clean, the airflow gets better. Make a practice of running the air conditioner at 25 or 26 degrees on warm days. Close doors and windows, and shade the sunny wall. Here is a quick list you can save on your phone.

AC Winter Maintenance Checklist

Use this AC winter maintenance checklist before you pack the AC away:

  • Clean and dry the filters
  • Run fan mode to dry the coils
  • Seal pipe gaps against pests
  • Cover the outdoor box with a breathable cover
  • Switch off the MCB or unplug the AC

March needs a few checks too.

What to Do When Winter Ends

Check the outdoor part for nests, chew marks, and loose wires. Clean the filters again, and make sure they are dry. Restore power, wait three minutes, and then switch on the AC. Call a technician if you notice a bad smell, ice, leaks, or weak cooling. Even if you do not notice anything unusual when summer comes back, you will have to call a technician. Because you cannot fully check the AC outdoor unit by yourself, as most of the outdoor units in Bangladesh are installed on the outside wall of the buildings.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS)

Question-1:

Do I need to service my AC before winter or before summer?

Both work, but a winter booking is easier because technicians are less busy. You should go before winter if the AC leaked, smelled, or cooled badly.

Question-2:

Should I completely turn off my AC in winter?

Yes, you can fully switch it off during the whole cooling season. The suggested method is to turn off the air conditioner with the remote, then wait for 3 minutes and use your MCB or the wall plug to do so.

Question-3:

Should I cover my split AC outdoor part in winter?

Yes, you need to cover only the outdoor part, and using a breathable cover is recommended. In practice, split ACs don't need an indoor cover in winter. Remove the cover before you run the AC.

Question-4:

Is it safe to unplug the AC for the whole winter?

It is safe when the air conditioner plug and socket are in good shape. However, unplugging during storms and voltage trouble is a must for safety.

Question-5:

How often should I clean AC filters in winter?

Clean them once a month if you use the AC, and once before you store it. People in dusty areas of Dhaka should do it every two weeks.

Question-6:

Does the AC need a gas refill after winter?

No, a yearly refill is not always needed; only when low gas is detected. So ask your technician to do a leak test first.

Question-7:

What should I do with the AC when winter ends?

When winter ends, clean the filters, check for pests, and wait three minutes before turning on your air conditioner again after power returns. Book a service if the AC smells or cools weakly.

Final Thoughts

If you want to continue without damaging your AC or reducing maintenance costs, and stand by your air conditioner for summer, the good care you take today can save you from a sweaty April surprise. If your AC is old and keeps failing, a new air conditioner model may cost less than repeated repairs. Many buyers see Star Tech as one of Bangladesh’s most trusted appliance shops. Check their air conditioner range if you plan an upgrade.
